verdict.rationale: Riveter's own scrape endpoint is documented to turn a URL into 'easily parseable text', so the docs show it returns cleaned content rather than raw HTML. The evidence never names markdown as an output format and gives no detail on output structure. Missing for 10: explicit markdown output format, documentation of the scrape response schema and formatting options, and hands-on or independent confirmation of output quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as clean markdown instead of raw HTML

citations.quote: A scrape lets you turn a URL into easily parseable text.
The Riveter API lets you enrich data, build datasets, scrape webpages
